narration.zh: 万圣节到了！小兔好想去要糖。
narration.en: It's Halloween! Little Rabbit is excited to go trick-or-treat.
Little Rabbit's costume is a pumpkin!
Little Rabbit is ready to go trick-or-treat.

narration.zh: 小兔去敲猫叔叔的门。不给糖就捣蛋！
narration.en: Little Rabbit knocks on Mr. Cat's door. Trick or treat!

narration.zh: 猫叔叔给小兔一张贴纸。
narration.en: Mr. Cat gives Little Rabbit one sticker.

narration.zh: 小兔去敲熊阿姨的门。不给糖就捣蛋！
narration.en: Little Rabbit knocks on Ms. Bear's door. Trick or treat!

narration.zh: 熊阿姨给小兔两张贴纸。
narration.en: Ms. Bear gives Little Rabbit two stickers.

narration.zh: 最后一扇门啦！不给糖就捣蛋！
narration.en: One last door! Trick or treat!

narration.zh: 猫头鹰姐姐给小兔三张贴纸。
narration.en: Miss Owl gives Little Rabbit three stickers.

narration.zh: 我们来数一数小兔有多少张贴纸吧。
narration.en: Let's count how many stickers Little Rabbit has.

narration.zh: 小兔玩得很开心，现在该睡觉了。晚安！
narration.en: Little Rabbit enjoyed Halloween, but now it's time to sleep. Good night!
